case_target_freeze_policy: compute case targets once from reference-point microbenchmarks; supplemental target samples never revise case targets
target_axis_lookup: exact_measured_target_only; unmeasured interior and exterior targets return uncovered
extension: add target measurements from declared microbenchmarks before querying an uncovered target; version coverage and count all calls; never retune BC or use formal/holdout whole-graph PPA to train the global model
delay_interpretation: mapped implementation under the recorded synthesis target and SDC; never an intrinsic target-independent operator delay
budget_policy: Keep cumulative ledger; freeze actual feature/context/stage collection manifest and close full budget before step5 bulk physical work; refresh after step6 large-kernel measurements; step3 closure does not require whole-experiment funding
step3_target_probes: synthesis-only target-dependence and identity checks; not a completed D cost library

sensitivity_protocol.initial_probe_size: small declared study, e.g. two contrasting targets; select subsequent points from evidence and remaining budget
sensitivity_protocol.large_kernel_timing: step4 or step6 when actual implementation is available; not a step3 closing requirement
sensitivity_protocol.early_stop_scope: ending a predeclared small study is allowed; identical measured metrics never creates unmeasured target coverage
sensitivity_protocol.physical_comparison: same synthesis starting netlist, fixed L/II/library/VT/corner/seeds/utilization/density; state absolute vs proportional IO; compare physical structure and common-SDC paths, not own-SDC slack alone
sensitivity_protocol.ABC_diagnostic: keep ABC mapper diagnostic separate from full-design STA; no model-error ratio without proving same path and timing conventions
sensitivity_protocol.axes: ABC and SDC independently remain in identity and cache keys, irrespective of observed response
sensitivity_protocol.unobserved: unmeasured exact context/stage returns uncovered; no nearest point or extrapolation

revision_reason: Separate mandatory reference/exact D query coverage from predeclared representative sensitivity studies; no universal six-point obligation
mandatory_data: 1500ps reference microbenchmarks required by the frozen case-target formula, plus exact ABC/SDC targets and implementation features actually queried by D; no formal/holdout whole-graph training
probe_grid_status: available candidate points, not mandatory per family; completed multiplier six-point data retained
